node.title: Upstream fixed-union RS ray and Johnson compilers
node.statement: For one fixed union U of R+nu RS parity-check columns and t<R, transverse syndrome-line slopes with t-sparse lifts number at most floor(C(R+nu,nu+1)/(R-t)); at nu=1 this is floor(R(R+1)/(2(R-t))). In one fixed syndrome fiber, if h=R+nu-t and h^2>(R+nu)(nu-1), the t-sparse lifts number at most floor((R+nu)(h-nu+1)/(h^2-(R+nu)(nu-1))). This independently reconstructs the three fixed-union theorems at b13de811 and makes no all-chart claim.
